result.justification: The objective is clearly stated, focusing on examining SARS-CoV-2 IgG antibody titres post-vaccination in RVO patients, and the methodology is detailed with explicit sampling, measurement, and statistical analysis.

objective_evidence.quote: The objective of the present study is to examine the levels of SARS-CoV-2 IgG antibody titres post COVID-19 vaccine in retinal vein occlusion (RVO) patients and in healthy control group;

method_evidence.quote: A total of 215 patients with retinal vein occlusion (RVO) were consecutively recruited from the Retina Clinic... detailed history about COVID-19 infection, contact history and hospitalisation due to COVID-19 was taken.
